verdict.rationale: Dedicated, autoscaled deployment capacity is a fair axis for an inference provider like Groq, but the evidence never documents dedicated or isolated deployments. The service tiers (on-demand, flex, auto) and batch processing are shared-pool throughput and priority options, which are adjacent features and earn no credit for traffic isolation.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can deploy a model on dedicated GPU capacity with autoscaling so my traffic is isolated from the shared serverless pool
